设

S_n=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{1}{n+\sqrt{k}}
\]

因为

\[
\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1n=1
\]

所以

\[
1-S_n=\sum_{k=1}^n\left(\frac1n-\frac{1}{n+\sqrt{k}}\right)
=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{\sqrt{k}}{n(n+\sqrt{k})}
\]

于是

\[
\sqrt{n}(1-S_n)
=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{\sqrt{k}}{\sqrt{n}(n+\sqrt{k})}
\]

令

\[
x_k=\sqrt{\frac{k}{n}}
\]

则

\[
\sqrt{k}=\sqrt{n}\,x_k,\qquad 
n+\sqrt{k}=n\left(1+\frac{x_k}{\sqrt{n}}\right)
\]

因此

\[
\sqrt{n}(1-S_n)
=\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{x_k}{1+x_k/\sqrt{n}}
\]

注意到 \(0\le x_k\le 1\)，且

\[
0\le \frac{x_k}{\sqrt{n}}\le \frac1{\sqrt{n}}
\]

所以

\[
\left|\frac{x_k}{1+x_k/\sqrt{n}}-x_k\right|
\le \frac1{\sqrt{n}}
\]

从而

\[
\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{x_k}{1+x_k/\sqrt{n}}
=
\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n x_k+o(1)
\]

而

\[
\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n \sqrt{\frac{k}{n}}
\to \int_0^1 \sqrt{x}\,dx
=\frac23
\]

因此

\[
L=\frac23
\]
